properties.name: The stale shared daemon was stopped and six merged PRs are finally serving
properties.rationale: THIS CALL IS ITSELF THE VERIFICATION. `summary` and `rationale` are the fields #256 added to this constructor, and a stale server would have REFUSED them — the request struct is deny_unknown_fields — so the fact that this event exists with both populated proves the new binary is answering. The other four checks passed the same way: hierarchy_issues returned the three predicted findings, scan_nodes(level:"subsystem") returned exactly 8, get_skill("rules") named governance-proposal. The lesson worth keeping is the ORDER of what failed: a session restart did nothing, a /mcp reconnect did nothing, and only `--stop-shared` moved it — which is what STALE_NOTE has said since 2026-08-08 and what nothing surfaced until #259 put it on loop_status.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: pid 3861122 (`--serve-shared`, up 5h41m) was stopped with `--stop-shared` and respawned from the current binary. PRs #254-#259 are now actually being served, having been merged and green for hours without ever running live.
